def binmat(z,nb):
    e=np.linspace(z.min()-1e-9,z.max()+1e-9,nb+1)
    return np.column_stack([((z>=e[k])&(z<e[k+1])).astype(float) for k in range(nb)]), (e[:-1]+e[1:])/2
